C1037.title: Weibo Reports 9 Employee Fraud Cases Transferred to Judicial Authorities
C1037.summary: In November 2024, Weibo disclosed 9 employee fraud cases involving 10 individuals transferred to judicial authorities on suspicion of crimes. Among them, former channel department employee Zhao misappropriated company operational resources for personal sale, while former user operations staff Zhai and two others diverted company resources to run personal businesses.
